text:
Project settings live in `atdd-bun.yaml`:
- `topology:` → `plan_root`, `source_root`, `test_root`, `e2e_root` (defaults `plan`, `src/wagons`, `tests/wagons`, `e2e`).
- `frontend.viewports` → widths responsive specs render at; the smallest bounds fixed widths.
- `frontend.breakpoints` → the only widths media queries may use.

coverage.note: Bullet 1: topology keys and their defaults.
Bullets 2-3: frontend.viewports (smallest bounds fixed widths) and frontend.breakpoints (media query widths).

variants.note: Canonical text preserves the atdd-bun.yaml location, all four topology keys, and their corresponding defaults.
Canonical text preserves both frontend settings in atdd-bun.yaml, responsive render widths, the smallest viewport constraint on fixed widths, and permitted media-query widths.

audit.summary: All variant knowledge is carried by canonical text; no notGeneric entries are needed.
